description.message: Fill in logins from your VaultRust password safe. Works with the VaultRust app for Windows; nothing leaves your computer.

commandFill.message: Fill in the login for this site

noSite.message: Open a website to fill in one of its logins.

notSetUpTitle.message: VaultRust isn't set up for this browser

notSetUp.message: In VaultRust, open Settings → Browser extension and turn it on.

notRunning.message: Start it to fill in your logins.

disabledTitle.message: The browser extension is turned off

disabled.message: Turn it on in VaultRust under Settings → Browser extension.

connect.message: VaultRust asks you once to allow this browser to fill in your logins.

confirm.message: VaultRust is asking whether to connect this browser. Allow it there if it shows this code:

locked.message: Unlock it to see the logins for this site.

noReply.message: It may be busy with a dialog. Try again in a moment.

noForm.message: There is no login form on this page that VaultRust can fill in.

shortcutHint.message: Tip: Alt+Shift+L fills in the most recently used login.
